messages:
maya: Hey Sec team — need short-lived KMS unwrap permission (cloud-kms:decrypt) on projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/customer-123/cryptoKeys/transactions-key for verification after a rotate. 30m max, will run:
```
gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file=/tmp/ct.dat --plaintext-file=/tmp/pt.dat --location=global --keyring=customer-123 --key=transactions-key
```
Will record session, provide artifact, and drop perms immediately after. @jess @tobi

jess: What’s the risk / justification? Who signed off on the rotation?

maya: Rotation failed on staging and ops asked for a manual unwrap to validate the migration to the new keyring. We will not export customer data — just confirming ciphertext -> plaintext matches for the key material. Signed off by samir (ops lead).

tobi: We need an audit ticket and link to the runbook. Also require bastion jump + MFA for the session. Can you open a sec ticket and paste the ID here?

maya: Created SEC-4821. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-unwrap. I’ll be on the call and doing the command from the bastion; session recording enabled.

sec-bot: Recorded approval request SEC-4821. Note: automod requires two approvers for KMS unwrap actions.

jess: Approved for 30m via this thread. Conditions: session recording on, upload artifact to s3://audit-uploads/SEC-4821/, and run revoke script when done. :thumbsup:

tobi: Approve as well. I’ll trigger the temporary role grant in ~2m and post the grant ID here.

samir: Thanks — I’m monitoring metrics and will verify no unexpected access patterns.

maya: Starting now. Grant ID when live? I’ll run the command and drop results to SEC-4821/artifacts. Will revoke immediately after and post a short summary.
